text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi rāhula cakkhuṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti . aniccaṃ bhante . yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti . dukkhaṃ bhante . yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti . no hetaṃ bhante . rūpā niccā vā aniccā vāti . aniccā bhante .pe. cakkhuviññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti . aniccaṃ bhante . cakkhusamphasso nicco vā anicco vāti . anicco bhante . yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati
